items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: He sure is. He's a fine man, boy. You said Bill got a girlfriend, you think? Brossel?

ctx.x: I'll tell the boy I'm not seeing you. I'll tell you all right. All right, Bill, glad seeing you.
Bill, he's a nice guy. Marvelous. One of the finest guys, boy, in existence. That's right, boy. He sure is. He's a fine man, boy. You said Bill got a girlfriend, you think? Brossel?
